sections.title: Part I – Legal Basis of Claim for Relief

fields.label: Article
fields.summary: Enter article number of the Tax Treaty.

fields.label: Tax Treatment Under the Treaty
fields.summary: Select tax treatment: Exempt from Income Tax or Subject to Preferential Rate.

sections.title: Part II – Identification of Income Recipient

fields.label: Name of Income Recipient
fields.summary: Enter full name of the income recipient.

fields.label: Place of Residence in the Philippines
fields.summary: Enter complete address in the Philippines.

fields.label: Date of Birth (MM/DD/YYYY)
fields.summary: Enter birth date in MM/DD/YYYY format (e.g., 11/28/2025).

fields.label: Country where the recipient is taxable as resident and where he/she is to pay tax
Date of Arrival in the Philippines (MM/DD/YYYY)
fields.summary: Enter arrival date in MM/DD/YYYY format (e.g., 11/28/2025).

fields.label: Date of Final Departure from the Philippines (MM/DD/YYYY)
fields.summary: Enter departure date in MM/DD/YYYY format (e.g., 11/28/2025).

sections.title: Part III – Details of Income Payor / Foreign Employer

fields.label: Registered Name (Last Name, First Name, Middle Name for Individual OR Registered Name for Non-Individual)
fields.summary: Enter full name or registered name.

fields.label: Complete Address in the Country of Residence
fields.summary: Enter complete address in the country of residence.

fields.label: Does the income payor have a Permanent Establishment (PE) in the Philippines?
If yes, does the PE have a license to do business in the Philippines?
Taxpayer Identification Number of the PE
Address of the PE
fields.summary: Enter complete address of the PE.

fields.label: Date of Contract (MM/DD/YYYY)
fields.summary: Enter contract date in MM/DD/YYYY format (e.g., 11/28/2025).

fields.label: Days of Physical Presence in the Philippines
fields.summary: Enter number of days present in the Philippines.

fields.label: Date of Payment (MM/DD/YYYY)
fields.summary: Enter payment date in MM/DD/YYYY format (e.g., 11/28/2025).

fields.label: Who actually claimed a deduction for the remuneration?
fields.summary: Select Foreign Employer, PE in the Philippines, or Philippine Taxpayer.

Amount of Withholding Tax Paid, if any

fields.label: Date of Payment (MM/DD/YYYY)
fields.summary: Enter payment date in MM/DD/YYYY format (e.g., 11/28/2025).
